claims: Costco warehouses are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
All US Costco locations will be closed in observation of the holiday.
All US Costco locations will resume normal operating hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Costco standard operating hours are typically 10:00 AM – 8:30 PM.
Costco has 9:00 AM opening for Executive Members.
